notes:
Founder-led intro (Elena Park, founder/CTO). Inbound via self-serve sign-up; created account 2026-02-24, started basic tests.

Call summary (2026-03-03):
- Elena on call, very hands-on, founder doing vendor eval.
- Primary product: small ecommerce personalization widget + chat support triage.
- Current stack: lightweight Python backend on GCP, currently using OpenAI for chat + embeddings, cost ~ $1.2k/month.
- Why Redwood? interested in predictable cost + better throughput on bursts and open model options. "We need fewer surprises on monthly bills."

Requirements / acceptance criteria:
- Use cases: chat support triage (first-touch routing), product Q&A (doc search), order-summary emails (summarization).
- Monthly volume estimate: 10M-50M tokens (early), bursty traffic 200-300 qps during peak sale days.
- Latency SLO: median <250ms for chat token generation; p95 <600ms acceptable in most flows.
- Model preferences: open to mid-sized open models; cares about function calling and streaming.
- Routing/fallback: wants simple fallback to smaller model on cost spikes.
- Security: SOC2 required for vendor, SSO/SAML for team logins, audit logs, data retention policy (90 days), prefers US data residency.
- Billing: founder wants simple predictable pricing (flat monthly + per-token tiers) or clear per-token tiers; dislikes surprise spikes.

POC ask:
- 2-week POC using Redwood Hosted API; Redwood to provide test keys + starter config for batching/cache suggestions.
- Acceptance: routing accuracy >=95% for support triage sample set (provided), median latency <250ms under baseline volume (5 qps).

Timeline / activity log:
- 2026-02-24: self-serve signup, basic trial requests (small volume).
- 2026-03-03: discovery call (Fireflies ff_20260303_2749).

- 2026-03-11: founder uploaded sample support transcripts for eval.

Sales notes / objections:
- Price is main blocker. Elena repeatedly asked: "How do you compare to OpenAI and Anthropic on identical workload costs?"
- Concern about lock-in if they later want on-prem. For now wants hosted but clear path to Dedicated.
- Wants to see an apples-to-apples cost/latency table and a short checklist of switching steps.

Next steps (assigned):
- Maya: prepare Redwood vs OpenAI/Anthropic pricing comparison + example invoice, send by 2026-03-14.
- Rajat (SE): run small benchmark on candidate open models + share latency/throughput numbers for 5 qps and 50 qps by 2026-03-15.
